summary: Expire followed devices at their wall-clock deadline without requiring a new graph claim

replay.detail: Pairing and revocation selection remains fenced by the graph snapshot.

schema.detail: No database schema, projection version or wire-field changes.

rules.detail: Claim admission and graph rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The shared HTTP and followed device row builder evaluates grant expiration at read time. A deadline reread now removes expired active devices and updates bounded-window has_more even when the store index has not advanced. Snapshot authorization and pairing/revocation fences are preserved.

downtime.detail: Normal binary replacement enables the corrected expiration behavior.

recovery.detail: Existing authoritative reconnect snapshots remain unchanged.
